full_prompt_en: A pastel storybook illustration shows a pale yellow winged pony with abundant pink ringlets against a lightly textured ivory ground. Irregular beige and blush washes form a loose vertical patch behind the figure, fading into the cream margins without a defined landscape. Near the upper left of centre, the pony's oversized head turns three-quarters toward the left and tilts slightly upward. Two large turquoise eyes, one partly shortened by the turn, have dark pupils, pale highlights and curved upper lashes. A small open smile softens the rounded muzzle, and a pale rounded ear emerges beside the mane on the right side of the head. Thick rose-pink curls sweep over the forehead and cascade down both sides of the neck, with darker coral inner curves and light pink ridges separating their loops. The small buttery-yellow torso stands below the head, partly hidden by the mane. One foreleg bends upward at the lower left of the body, its hoof hanging clear of the ground, while the other three legs extend downward with slight overlapping bends. Warm peach shadows define their inner surfaces, and their broad rounded hoof ends touch a faint beige ground mark. Behind the shoulder, a long feathered wing rises diagonally toward the upper right, with pale cream tips and peach outlines dividing the layered feathers. A small pastel-coloured mark appears on the flank below it. The voluminous pink tail curls outward along the right side and descends into loose spirals near the lower corner. Broad, soft illumination from above and the left adds light edges to the curls and feathers, while gentle warm shadows give the body rounded volume. The overall composition combines an upward-looking expression, raised foreleg and flowing diagonal wing in an airy arrangement of butter yellow, rose pink and warm ivory.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅粉彩童书插画表现一匹披着丰厚粉色卷发的浅黄有翼小马，背景是带轻微纹理的象牙白底。小马后方不规则米色与淡粉洗色组成松散竖向色片，向奶油色边缘渐淡，没有具体风景。中央偏左上方，小马偏大的头以四分之三角度转向左方，并微微向上仰起。两只蓝绿色大眼睛带深色瞳孔、浅色亮点与弯曲上睫毛，其中一只因转头而显得较窄。圆润口鼻露出小小的张口微笑，头部右侧鬃毛旁伸出一只浅色圆拢耳朵。粗厚玫瑰粉卷发扫过额头，沿颈部两侧层层垂落，较深珊瑚色内弧与浅粉亮脊分开圈圈卷发。奶油黄小躯干立在头下，部分被鬃毛遮住。身体左下方一条前腿向上弯起，蹄子悬在地面之上，另外三条腿稍有交叠弯曲地向下伸展。暖桃色阴影刻画腿内侧，宽圆蹄端落在浅淡米色地面痕迹上。肩后长羽翼斜向右上展开，浅奶油色羽尖与桃色轮廓分开层叠羽片。翅膀下方侧腹有一小块粉彩色标记。丰厚粉色尾巴沿右侧向外卷起，在右下角附近垂成松散螺旋。上方偏左的宽阔柔光在卷发和羽片边缘带出亮色，温和暖影让躯体显出圆润体积。整体构图以仰望神情、抬起前腿和流畅斜向羽翼形成轻盈布局，将奶油黄、玫瑰粉与暖象牙白结合起来。
style_prompt_en: The illustration uses soft pastel fills, fine coloured outlines and rounded, clearly separated forms. Warm cream and pale yellow sit beside rose, coral and occasional turquoise, with low contrast keeping the surface gentle. Curved contours and layered shapes create rhythm, while small highlights clarify overlap without hard shine. A faint paper grain and lightly washed background soften the silhouette. Broad diffuse light produces mild warm shadows and restrained volume. Open negative space around a single focal form gives the composition an airy storybook quality, balancing delicate linework with simple colour masses.
style_prompt_zh: 插画采用柔和粉彩色面、细彩色轮廓和圆润清楚的分离形体。暖奶油色与浅黄旁边搭配玫瑰粉、珊瑚色和少量青绿，低反差使表面保持轻柔。弯曲轮廓与层叠形状形成节奏，小块亮色说明遮挡关系，却不产生硬亮光泽。淡纸纹和浅洗色背景柔化外形。宽阔漫射光带来微暖阴影和克制体积感。单一焦点周围的开阔负空间赋予构图轻盈童书感，并平衡细腻线条与简洁色块。
theme_en: A pale yellow winged pony with pink ringlets raises one foreleg and looks upward
theme_zh: 浅黄有翼小马垂着粉色卷发，抬起一条前腿并向上望
name: My Little Pony
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
